SystemTable.name: cache_user
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cache_user` ( `id` bigint(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `user_name` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `password` varchar(256) NOT NULL COMMENT 'encrypted by PasswdUtil', `read_priv` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `write_priv` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `admin_priv` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_user_name` (`user_name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Cache service user authentication'

SystemTable.name: cache_peer
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cache_peer` ( `id` bigint(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `peer_name` varchar(512) NOT NULL COMMENT 'unique peer node name', `host` varchar(256) NOT NULL COMMENT 'ip:port of cache rpc service', `node_hash` bigint(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'xxhash64 of peer node name for consistent hashing', `lease` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'the expiration time of this lease in UTC ms', `role` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OTHERS' COMMENT 'peer role: CACHE_WRITER, CACHE_READER, OTHERS', `leader` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'whether this peer is the leader (1=leader, 0=follower)', `status_json` longtext DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'peer status in JSON format for future extensibility', `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_peer_name` (`peer_name`), KEY `idx_leader_lease` (`leader`, `lease`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='Cache service peer node registry and leader election'

SystemTable.name: cache_file_mapping
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cache_file_mapping` ( `id` bigint(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'file id', `gmt_created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `gmt_modified` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'file name', `logical_schema` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'logical schema for cleanup', `logical_table` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'logical table for cleanup', `part_name` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'partition name for cleanup', `engine` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'engine type for cleanup', `meta` longblob DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'file metadata', `version` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'version for optimistic locking', `locked` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'whether this file is locked (1=locked, 0=unlocked)', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_file_name` (`file_name`), KEY `idx_schema_table_part` (`logical_schema`, `logical_table`, `part_name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Cache file name to file id mapping'
